title: Cooling Fan COMPONENTS FOR REMOVAL AND INSTALLATION

EG–354
ENGINE – COOLING SYSTEM

Cooling Fan
COMPONENTS FOR REMOVAL AND
INSTALLATION

Cooling Fan Connector
Cooling Fan

Engine Under Cover

 x18

P18YY

Ammeter          Fan Connector
2.5 – 4.5A

Battery

P11774

COOLING FAN INSPECTION
INSPECT COOLING FAN
(a)  Disconnect the fan connector.
(b)  Connect battery and ammeter to the cooling fan connector.
(c)  Check that the cooling fan rotates smoothly, and check the
       reading on the ammeter.
       Standard amperage:
           2.5–4.5 A
(d)  Reconnect the fan connector.
